courseText.en: A 12-hour course across 19 modules, based on Node.js on AWS, on deploying scalable, highly available applications.

intro.en: Today I work as Principal Innovation Architect at Caylent’s Office of the CTO, helping turn emerging cloud and AI ideas into useful systems and clear explanations.
